fire_front_basis: A deliberately declared screening threshold, not a measured physical limit. A 500 m cell per minute is 30 km/h. Coarse cell activation does not establish a measured front speed.
ground_speed_basis: Maximum declared road edge speed; straight-line minute displacement is only a necessary lower-bound check, not route reconstruction.
air_speed_basis: Profile flight speed; recovery does not require a new drop clearance.
timing_basis: Scenario profile setup, refill and rest durations; inherited on-scene setup is unobserved.
land_basis: Apply supplied authoritative estimated land/sea mask only; fixture has no sea evidence.
exercise_not_law: No universal minimum fire area, aircraft legal minima, labour law, or validated nighttime rules are inferred.
